description.value: The Shadbolt Centre for the Arts is an award-winning, multi-purpose community arts facility set within Deer Lake Park in Burnaby, named after acclaimed BC painter Jack Shadbolt and his wife Doris. It hosts theatre performances, festivals, fine arts programs, and exhibitions, and includes an art supply store on site. The park setting makes it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Deer Lake area.
